content:
To **move** a [node](DOM#concept-node) *node* into a [node](DOM#concept-node) *newParent* before null or a [node](DOM#concept-node) *child*:

1. If *newParent*’s [shadow-including root](DOM#concept-shadow-including-root) is not the same as *node*’s [shadow-including root](DOM#concept-shadow-including-root), then [throw](WEBIDL#dfn-throw) a "[`HierarchyRequestError`](WEBIDL#hierarchyrequesterror)" [`DOMException`](WEBIDL#idl-DOMException).

    > **Note:** This has the side effect of ensuring that a move is only performed if *newParent*’s [connected](DOM#connected) is *node*’s [connected](DOM#connected).
2. If *node* is a [host-including inclusive ancestor](DOM#concept-tree-host-including-inclusive-ancestor) of *newParent*, then [throw](WEBIDL#dfn-throw) a "[`HierarchyRequestError`](WEBIDL#hierarchyrequesterror)" [`DOMException`](WEBIDL#idl-DOMException).
3. If *child* is non-null and its [parent](DOM#concept-tree-parent) is not *newParent*, then [throw](WEBIDL#dfn-throw) a "[`NotFoundError`](WEBIDL#notfounderror)" [`DOMException`](WEBIDL#idl-DOMException).
4. If *node* is not an [`Element`](DOM#element) or a [`CharacterData`](DOM#characterdata) [node](DOM#concept-node), then [throw](WEBIDL#dfn-throw) a "[`HierarchyRequestError`](WEBIDL#hierarchyrequesterror)" [`DOMException`](WEBIDL#idl-DOMException).
5. If *node* is a [`Text`](DOM#text) [node](DOM#concept-node) and *newParent* is a [document](DOM#concept-document), then [throw](WEBIDL#dfn-throw) a "[`HierarchyRequestError`](WEBIDL#hierarchyrequesterror)" [`DOMException`](WEBIDL#idl-DOMException).
6. If *newParent* is a [document](DOM#concept-document), *node* is an [`Element`](DOM#element) [node](DOM#concept-node), and either *newParent* has an [element](DOM#concept-element) [child](DOM#concept-tree-child), *child* is a [doctype](DOM#concept-doctype), or *child* is non-null and a [doctype](DOM#concept-doctype) is [following](DOM#concept-tree-following) *child* then [throw](WEBIDL#dfn-throw) a "[`HierarchyRequestError`](WEBIDL#hierarchyrequesterror)" [`DOMException`](WEBIDL#idl-DOMException).
7. Let *oldParent* be *node*’s [parent](DOM#concept-tree-parent).
8. [Assert](INFRA#assert): *oldParent* is non-null.
9. Run the [live range pre-remove steps](DOM#live-range-pre-remove-steps), given *node*.
10. For each [`NodeIterator`](DOM#nodeiterator) object *iterator* whose [root](DOM#concept-traversal-root)’s [node document](DOM#concept-node-document) is *node*’s [node document](DOM#concept-node-document): run the [`NodeIterator` pre-remove steps](DOM#nodeiterator-pre-removing-steps) given *node* and *iterator*.
11. Let *oldPreviousSibling* be *node*’s [previous sibling](DOM#concept-tree-previous-sibling).
12. Let *oldNextSibling* be *node*’s [next sibling](DOM#concept-tree-next-sibling).
13. [Remove](INFRA#list-remove) *node* from *oldParent*’s [children](DOM#concept-tree-child).
14. If *node* is [assigned](DOM#slotable-assigned), then run [assign slottables](DOM#assign-slotables) for *node*’s [assigned slot](DOM#slotable-assigned-slot).
15. If *oldParent*’s [root](DOM#concept-tree-root) is a [shadow root](DOM#concept-shadow-root), and *oldParent* is a [slot](DOM#concept-slot) whose [assigned nodes](DOM#slot-assigned-nodes) [is empty](INFRA#list-is-empty), then run [signal a slot change](DOM#signal-a-slot-change) for *oldParent*.
16. If *node* has an [inclusive descendant](DOM#concept-tree-inclusive-descendant) that is a [slot](DOM#concept-slot):

    1. Run [assign slottables for a tree](DOM#assign-slotables-for-a-tree) with *oldParent*’s [root](DOM#concept-tree-root).
    2. Run [assign slottables for a tree](DOM#assign-slotables-for-a-tree) with *node*.
17. [Add transient registered observers](DOM#add-transient-registered-observers) given *node* and *oldParent*.
18. If *child* is non-null:

    1. For each [live range](DOM#concept-live-range) whose [start node](DOM#concept-range-start-node) is *newParent* and [start offset](DOM#concept-range-start-offset) is greater than *child*’s [index](DOM#concept-tree-index): increase its [start offset](DOM#concept-range-start-offset) by 1.
    2. For each [live range](DOM#concept-live-range) whose [end node](DOM#concept-range-end-node) is *newParent* and [end offset](DOM#concept-range-end-offset) is greater than *child*’s [index](DOM#concept-tree-index): increase its [end offset](DOM#concept-range-end-offset) by 1.
19. Let *newPreviousSibling* be *child*’s [previous sibling](DOM#concept-tree-previous-sibling) if *child* is non-null, and *newParent*’s [last child](DOM#concept-tree-last-child) otherwise.
20. If *child* is null, then [append](INFRA#set-append) *node* to *newParent*’s [children](DOM#concept-tree-child).
21. Otherwise, [insert](INFRA#list-insert) *node* into *newParent*’s [children](DOM#concept-tree-child) before *child*’s [index](DOM#concept-tree-index).
22. If *newParent* is a [shadow host](DOM#element-shadow-host) whose [shadow root](DOM#concept-shadow-root)’s [slot assignment](DOM#shadowroot-slot-assignment) is "`named`" and *node* is a [slottable](DOM#concept-slotable), then [assign a slot](DOM#assign-a-slot) for *node*.
23. If *newParent*’s [root](DOM#concept-tree-root) is a [shadow root](DOM#concept-shadow-root), and *newParent* is a [slot](DOM#concept-slot) whose [assigned nodes](DOM#slot-assigned-nodes) [is empty](INFRA#list-is-empty), then run [signal a slot change](DOM#signal-a-slot-change) for *newParent*.
24. Run [assign slottables for a tree](DOM#assign-slotables-for-a-tree) with *node*’s [root](DOM#concept-tree-root).
25. For each [shadow-including inclusive descendant](DOM#concept-shadow-including-inclusive-descendant) *inclusiveDescendant* of *node*, in [shadow-including tree order](DOM#concept-shadow-including-tree-order):

    1. Let *isSubtreeRoot* be true if *inclusiveDescendant* is *node*; otherwise false.
    2. Run the [moving steps](DOM#concept-node-move-ext) with *inclusiveDescendant*, *isSubtreeRoot*, and *oldParent*.

        > **Note:** Because the [move](DOM#move) algorithm is a separate primitive from [insert](DOM#concept-node-insert) and [remove](DOM#concept-node-remove), it does not invoke the [insertion steps](DOM#concept-node-insert-ext) or [removing steps](DOM#concept-node-remove-ext) for *inclusiveDescendant*.
    3. If *inclusiveDescendant* is [custom](DOM#concept-element-custom) and *newParent* is [connected](DOM#connected), then [enqueue a custom element callback reaction](HTML#enqueue-a-custom-element-callback-reaction) with *inclusiveDescendant*, callback name "`connectedMoveCallback`", and « ».
26. [Queue a tree mutation record](DOM#queue-a-tree-mutation-record) for *oldParent* with « », « *node* », *oldPreviousSibling*, and *oldNextSibling*.
27. [Queue a tree mutation record](DOM#queue-a-tree-mutation-record) for *newParent* with « *node* », « », *newPreviousSibling*, and *child*.
title: move
